description: Set which topics a person receives, recording what they asked for — silently re-subscribing someone who opted out is what generates spam complaints. Every key must be an existing topic from list_topics: one unknown key refuses the whole call with 422 unknown_topic and nothing is saved. Setting a topic to false also ends any automation enrolment sent under that topic.

topics.description: Topic key to subscribed, e.g. {"newsletter": false}

name: set_email_preferences
